sloka: भस्मी भूता दुरात्मानो भविष्यन्ति न संशयः ।अद्य ते काल पाशेन नीता वैवस्तव क्षयम् ॥१-५९-१८॥
transliteration: bhasmī bhūtā durātmāno bhaviṣyanti na saṁśayaḥ ।adya te kāla pāśena nītā vaivastava kṣayam ॥1-59-18॥

translations.english: Caught by the noose of death this day, they shall be brought to the abode of Yama and for seven hundred births, feed on corpses.
